ALD.Title: Assets Doctor
ALD.Subtitle: Finds missing files and replaces their paths. Nothing changes until you apply.
ALD.Empty: Nothing to show with these filters.
ALD.MoreRefs: ... and {n} more uses (use the CSV to see all)
ALD.NotGM: Only the GM can use Assets Doctor.

D.SystemOther: This path belongs to system '{id}', which is not this world's system.
D.Missing: File not found in the folder.
D.Case: Different upper/lower case. The real file is: {name}
D.WrongType: Type does not fit the field (expected: {expected}, found: {found}).
D.WildEmptyDir: Wildcard matched nothing and the folder does not exist.
D.WildEmpty: No files found for this wildcard.
D.WildWrong: {n} files, none of the expected type ({expected}).
D.WildMixed: {n} files, {bad} are not the expected type ({expected}).
D.FolderMissing: The search folder does not exist.
D.InactiveOwner: Data from module {id}. Ignored because the module is not active. (Status: {was})
D.Placeholder: Looks like an example value saved by a module, not a real file.
D.FromFlag: Comes from data of module '{id}', which is not installed.
D.MissingInDir: File not found. The folder exists and has {n} files.

Menu.Name: Assets Doctor
Menu.Label: Open checker
Menu.Hint: Finds missing files in scenes, actors, journals, playlists and compendiums.

ALD.FiltersTitle: Filter the result list (it does not search new files, it only filters what the scan found)
ALD.FieldTextHelp: Shows only rows containing this text in the path or where it is used.
ALD.FieldFolderHelp: Shows only paths starting like this. Useful to check one module or folder.
ALD.FieldExtHelp: You can type several, separated by commas.
ALD.OptWorldHelp: Scenes, actors, items, journals, playlists, tables and macros of this world. Does not open compendiums.
ALD.OptModPacksHelp: Much slower. Only if you need it.
ALD.OptModuleHelp: Checks the compendiums of one module (useful when building a module).
ALD.NeedScope: Select at least one option above to scan.
ALD.OwnerTip: Module that saved this data inside the document
ALD.StaleCache: Assets Doctor: your browser is using old module files. Reload with Ctrl+F5 (or clear the cache) to update.

Pick.Title: Choose module
Pick.Help: Only active modules that have compendiums are listed. Pick one and click Choose (or double-click).
Pick.None: No active module has compendiums to check.

ALD.BulkTip: Replaces paths in every item in the list (filters apply).
ALD.UndoConfirm: Undo the last replacement? {n} documents go back to their previous value.
ALD.SearchPh: Filter by file, document or scene name...
ALD.ReplaceTip: Replace this file in all its uses

Rep.Title: Replace paths
Rep.TitleSingle: Replace this file in all its uses
Rep.NewPathHelp: Type or paste the path (with spaces or %20, either works) or use Browse to pick the new file.
Rep.BulkHint: Applies to the {n} items in the list (with the filters already applied). Tip: filter by type, extension or folder first.
Rep.OnlyExisting: Only replace when the new file exists
Rep.OnlyExistingHelp: Avoids swapping a broken link for another broken link.
Rep.Backup: Save a backup file before replacing
Rep.BackupHelp: Downloads a .json with the old values. You can also undo from the main window button.
Rep.BackupFailed: Could not save the backup file.
Rep.Summary: {paths} paths | {uses} uses | {ok} with an existing new file | {missing} without a new file
Rep.NothingToChange: No documents to change. {n} uses could not be located.
Rep.ConfirmText: Replace {paths} paths in {docs} documents ({uses} uses)? This writes to your world data.
Rep.ConfirmBackup: A backup file will be downloaded first.
Rep.Unresolved: {n} uses could not be located automatically (they may live in other modules' data).
Rep.RescanNote: The list will refresh with a new scan.
Rep.NoMatch: No item in the list matches this rule.
Rep.TypeToPreview: Type above to see the preview.
Rep.MoreRows: ... and {n} more items (all will be replaced).

ALD.SettingsButtonTip: Open the asset checker and replacer
